name: MLB Live Command Center V11.13 Audited Hybrid Data + Full Empirical
description: V11.13 production dashboard with audited hybrid polling/cache architecture: canonical MLB live snapshots, 4-second live timeout, rapid bounded retries, proactive complete active-roster pregame MLB-stat and Statcast caching, cache invalidation on matchup changes, FULL/DEGRADED/PRIOR model-input quality classification, plus all approved empirical state/count/PA-transition/bullpen/removal/reliever-choice probability components.
commit_message: Deploy audited hybrid data polling with full empirical engine

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>MLB Live Command Center V11.13</title>
<style>
:root{
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg:#07111f;--panel:#0d1b2a;--panel2:#13263a;--line:#29415c;
  --text:#f3f7fb;--muted:#9fb0c3;--accent:#39d98a;--warn:#ffd166;--danger:#ff6b6b;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:rgba(7,17,31,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px}
.top{max-width:1500px;margin:auto;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
h1{font-size:18px;margin:0 auto 0 0}
.controls{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
input,select,button{font:inherit;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);padding:8px 10px}
button{cursor:pointer}
button:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.status{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
main{max-width:1500px;margin:auto;padding:12px}
.summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}
.metric{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:10px}
.metric b{display:block;font-size:22px}.metric span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(330px,1fr));gap:10px}
.game{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
.game.live{border-color:var(--accent)}
.gamehead{padding:10px 12px;background:var(--panel2);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.badge{font-size:11px;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:#21364d;color:var(--muted)}
.badge.live{background:rgba(57,217,138,.14);color:var(--accent)}
.priority-badge{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(57,217,138,.12);color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}
.game.pinned{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,209,102,.45),0 0 18px rgba(255,209,102,.10)}
.teams{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:5px 12px;padding:11px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.team{font-weight:650}.score{font-size:20px;font-weight:750;text-align:right}
.state{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);padding:0 12px 10px}
.situation{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:10px;padding:11px 12px}
.label{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:3px}
.value{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.bases{width:78px;height:62px;position:relative;margin:3px auto 0}
.base{position:absolute;width:19px;height:19px;border:2px solid var(--muted);transform:rotate(45deg);background:transparent}
.base.on{background:var(--warn);border-color:var(--warn)}
.first{right:8px;top:23px}.second{left:30px;top:2px}.third{left:8px;top:23px}
.counts{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;font-size:12px;margin-top:5px;color:var(--muted)}
.details{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;padding:0 12px 12px}
.lineups{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;padding:0 12px 12px}
.lineup-panel{background:#0a1725;border:1px solid #20364d;border-radius:9px;padding:9px}
.lineup-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:7px;align-items:center;padding:6px 0;border-top:1px solid #20364d}
.lineup-row:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.slot{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.ops{font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.rei-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;padding:0 12px 12px}
.rei-panel{background:#0a1725;border:1px solid #20364d;border-radius:10px;padding:10px}
.run-dist{margin-top:12px;padding-top:11px;border-top:1px solid #20364d}
.run-dist-head{margin-bottom:9px;color:#9fb0c4;font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.10em}
.run-line-ladder{display:grid;gap:2px}
.run-prob-head,.run-line-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:5px;align-items:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.run-prob-head{padding:0 4px 3px;color:#73869f;font-size:8px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.run-prob-head span:not(:first-child){text-align:right}
.run-line-row{padding:4px;border-radius:6px;color:#aeb9c8;font-size:11px}
.run-line-row .threshold{font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.run-prob-cell{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.run-prob-cell b{font-size:11px;color:#e7eef7}
.run-prob-cell small{font-size:9px;color:#8193aa;margin-left:2px}
.run-line-row.actionable .cum b,.run-line-row.primary .cum b{color:var(--accent)}
.run-line-row.primary{background:rgba(57,217,138,.08);box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 rgba(57,217,138,.60)}
.run-line-expected{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:11px;padding:11px 7px 2px;border-top:1px solid #20364d;color:#c1cad6;font-size:15px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.run-line-expected b{font-size:17px;color:#eef5ff}
.combined-inning{margin:4px 8px 2px;padding:4px 6px;background:#081421;border:1px solid #20364d;border-radius:7px}
.combined-inning-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:2px;line-height:1}
.combined-inning-title{font-size:7px;color:#8fa2bd;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;white-space:nowrap}
.combined-inning-exp{font-size:7.5px;color:#aebccc;white-space:nowrap}.combined-inning-exp b{font-size:9px;color:#eef5ff}
.combined-inning-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:2px}
.combined-inning-cell{min-width:0;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:baseline;gap:2px;padding:2px 1px;border-radius:4px;background:#0d1b2b;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.combined-inning-cell span{display:inline;font-size:6.5px;color:#71849d;text-transform:uppercase}
.combined-inning-cell b{display:inline;font-size:8.5px;line-height:1;color:#eef5ff}
.combined-inning-cell small{display:inline;font-size:6.5px;color:#8294aa;line-height:1}


.rei-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start}
.rei-prob{font-size:25px;font-weight:800;line-height:1}
.rei-odds{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.cat{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:999px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.stoplight{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;flex:0 0 11px;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.cat.low{background:rgba(255,107,107,.14);color:var(--danger)}
.cat.low .stoplight{background:#ff4d4d;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,77,77,.8)}
.cat.baseline{background:rgba(255,209,102,.14);color:var(--warn)}
.cat.baseline .stoplight{background:#ffd166;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,209,102,.75)}
.cat.high{background:rgba(57,217,138,.14);color:var(--accent)}
.cat.high .stoplight{background:#39d98a;animation:greenPulse 1.05s ease-in-out infinite;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(57,217,138,.95)}
@keyframes greenPulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(57,217,138,.65)}50%{opacity:.25;transform:scale(.82);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(57,217,138,1)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cat.high .stoplight{animation:none}}
.rei-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-top:10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.market-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:7px;align-items:center;margin-top:9px}
.market-odds{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px}
.ev{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}.ev.pos{color:var(--accent)}.ev.neg{color:var(--danger)}

.detail{background:#0a1725;border:1px solid #20364d;border-radius:9px;padding:8px}
.detail .value{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.footer{padding:9px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.health{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.health-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}.health.delayed .health-dot{background:var(--warn)}.health.stale .health-dot,.health.disconnected .health-dot{background:var(--danger)}
.readiness{margin:0 12px 12px;background:#0a1725;border:1px solid #20364d;border-radius:10px;padding:10px}
.readiness-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px}
.ready-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px 10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.ready-item{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}.ready-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--danger)}
.ready-item.ok .ready-dot{background:var(--accent)}.ready-item.partial .ready-dot{background:var(--warn)}
.pregame-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;padding:0 12px 12px}
.pregame-panel{background:#0a1725;border:1px solid #20364d;border-radius:10px;padding:10px}
.odds-note{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
.error{border:1px solid var(--danger);color:var(--danger);padding:12px;border-radius:10px}
.empty{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);padding:40px 10px}
@media(max-width:620px){.summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.situation{grid-template-columns:1fr 120px}.rei-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* V11.5 compact mobile-first live dashboard */
.compact-game-header{padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.compact-scoreline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:7px}
.compact-team-name{font-size:clamp(12px,3.3vw,15px);font-weight:750;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.compact-team-name.home{text-align:right}.compact-score{font-size:clamp(22px,6.4vw,31px);font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap}
.compact-subline{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:clamp(10px,2.7vw,12px);margin-top:2px}
.compact-matchup{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:7px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#0a1725}
.compact-player{min-width:0}.compact-player.right{text-align:right}.compact-player .primary{font-size:clamp(12px,3.2vw,14px);font-weight:750;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.compact-player .secondary{font-size:clamp(9px,2.5vw,11px);color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.compact-vs{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}
.batter-primary-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-width:0}.batter-primary-line .primary{min-width:0;flex:0 1 auto}.pitch-count-dots{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;flex:0 0 auto}.count-dot-group{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}.count-dot-label{font-size:8px;font-weight:900;color:var(--warn);margin-right:1px}.count-divider{width:1px;height:18px;background:#718095;opacity:.72}.count-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,209,102,.62);background:transparent}.count-dot.filled{background:var(--warn);border-color:var(--warn);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(255,209,102,.45)}
.compact-team-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:7px;padding:8px}.compact-team-card{min-width:0;background:#0a1725;border:1px solid #20364d;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}.compact-team-head{padding:7px 8px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #20364d}.compact-team-head-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:5px;align-items:baseline}.compact-team-head strong{min-width:0;font-size:clamp(10px,2.8vw,12px);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.compact-role{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}.compact-primary-metric{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;margin-top:2px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.compact-primary-metric b{font-size:clamp(20px,5.7vw,27px);line-height:1}.compact-primary-metric span{font-size:clamp(9px,2.5vw,11px);color:var(--muted)}
.compact-ladder{padding:5px 7px}.compact-run-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 38px 58px;gap:3px;align-items:center;min-height:22px;font-size:clamp(10px,2.75vw,12px);color:#b5c0cd;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;border-radius:5px;padding:1px 3px}.compact-run-row .p,.compact-run-row .o{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}.compact-run-row.actionable{color:var(--accent);font-weight:800}.compact-run-row.primary{background:rgba(57,217,138,.10);box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 rgba(57,217,138,.7)}
.compact-next{border-top:1px solid #20364d;padding:5px 7px}.compact-next-title{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:2px}.compact-next-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:20px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:3px;font-size:clamp(9px,2.55vw,11px);line-height:1.35;align-items:center}.compact-next-row span:nth-child(2){white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.compact-next-row .ops-mini{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted)}
.compact-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:0 8px 8px}.compact-actions details{flex:1;min-width:0;background:#0a1725;border:1px solid #20364d;border-radius:8px}.compact-actions summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;padding:7px 8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;color:#c6d1df}.compact-actions summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.compact-actions .details-body{padding:0 7px 7px}.compact-actions .market-row{margin-top:5px}.compact-actions .market-odds{font-size:10px;padding:5px 6px}.compact-actions .ev{font-size:10px}.compact-diag-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px;margin-top:6px;font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:620px){header{padding:7px 8px}.top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:5px 7px}.top h1{font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}.controls{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto auto;gap:5px}.controls input,.controls select,.controls button{min-width:0;padding:6px 7px;font-size:11px}.controls #sort{display:none}.controls label{font-size:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}.controls .status{grid-column:1/-1;font-size:9px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}main{padding:7px}.summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:4px;margin-bottom:6px}.metric{padding:5px 6px;border-radius:8px}.metric b{font-size:15px}.metric span{font-size:8px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.grid{gap:7px}.gamehead{display:none}.teams,.state,.situation,.rei-grid,.lineups,.details{display:none!important}.footer{display:none}}
@media(max-width:360px){.compact-team-grid{gap:4px;padding:5px}.compact-run-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 34px 51px;font-size:9px}.compact-team-head{padding:6px}.compact-next{padding:4px 5px}}


.live-transition-tag{font-size:7px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--warn);padding:2px 4px;border:1px solid rgba(255,209,102,.35);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,209,102,.08);white-space:nowrap}
/* V11.7 consolidated live scoreboard header */
.live-scoreboard-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:5px 8px;padding:7px 10px;background:var(--panel2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.live-venue{min-width:0;font-size:clamp(11px,3vw,14px);font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.live-status-center{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:24px;white-space:nowrap;border-top:1px solid rgba(159,176,195,.14);padding-top:5px}
.live-inning{font-size:clamp(10px,2.8vw,12px);font-weight:900;color:var(--accent);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.035em}
.live-status-divider{width:1px;height:20px;background:#718095;opacity:.6}
.live-outs-label{font-size:clamp(9px,2.5vw,11px);font-weight:750;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.live-outs-circle{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:#06111b;box-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(57,217,138,.3)}
.live-outs-circle.outs-0{background:var(--accent)}
.live-outs-circle.outs-1{background:var(--warn)}
.live-outs-circle.outs-2{background:var(--danger);color:#fff}
.live-outs-circle.outs-3{background:#8d99a8;color:#08111d}
.live-priority-wrap{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;min-width:0}
.probability-signal{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;flex:0 0 14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.probability-signal.low{background:#ff4d4d;box-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(255,77,77,.8)}
.probability-signal.baseline{background:#ffd166;box-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(255,209,102,.75)}
.probability-signal.high{background:#39d98a;animation:headerGreenPulse 1.05s ease-in-out infinite;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(57,217,138,.95)}
@keyframes headerGreenPulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(57,217,138,.65)}50%{opacity:.28;transform:scale(.78);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(57,217,138,1)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.probability-signal.high{animation:none}}
.live-scoreboard-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.score-team{min-width:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.score-team.home{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr)}
.score-team-meta{min-width:0}.score-team.home .score-team-meta{text-align:right}
.score-team-name{font-size:clamp(10px,2.9vw,13px);font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.score-team-record{font-size:clamp(8px,2.3vw,10px);color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px}
.score-team-value{font-size:clamp(25px,7vw,34px);font-weight:900;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.score-center{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto auto;justify-items:center;align-items:center;gap:5px;min-width:82px}
.score-bases{width:50px;height:40px;position:relative;margin:0 3px}
.score-bases .base{width:14px;height:14px;border-width:1.5px}
.score-bases .first{right:4px;top:17px}.score-bases .second{left:18px;top:1px}.score-bases .third{left:4px;top:17px}
.score-count{min-height:18px}
.score-count .count-dot{width:9px;height:9px}
.score-count .count-dot-label{font-size:7px}
.score-count .count-divider{height:17px}

/* V11.13 top-quarter mobile compaction */
@media(max-width:620px){
  header{padding:4px 6px}
  .top{gap:3px 5px}
  .top h1{font-size:12px;line-height:1.15}
  .top h1 .badge{font-size:8px;padding:2px 5px}
  .controls{gap:3px;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto auto}
  .controls input,.controls select,.controls button{padding:4px 5px;font-size:9px;border-radius:7px}
  .controls label{font-size:8px}
  .controls .status{font-size:7.5px;line-height:1.05}

  main{padding:5px 6px}
  .summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;margin-bottom:4px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden}
  .metric{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;padding:3px 4px;text-align:center;border-left:1px solid rgba(159,176,195,.12)}
  .metric:first-child{border-left:0}
  .metric b{display:inline;font-size:10px;line-height:1;margin-right:2px}
  .metric span{display:inline;font-size:6px;line-height:1;color:var(--muted)}
  .metric:last-child{flex:1.35}
  .metric:last-child b{font-size:8px}

  .grid{gap:5px}
  .game{border-radius:11px}

  .live-scoreboard-top{
    grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto auto;
    gap:4px;
    padding:4px 6px;
    align-items:center;
  }
  .live-venue{font-size:9px}
  .live-status-center{
    grid-column:auto;

function empiricalPATransitions(kind,outs,mask){
  const key=`${kind}|${outs}|${mask}`;
  const rows=EMPIRICAL_PA_TRANSITION_MODEL.states?.[key];
  if(!Array.isArray(rows)||!rows.length) throw new Error(`Missing empirical PA transition state ${key}`);
  return rows;
}
function runDistribution(lineup,startIdx,pitcherId,outs=0,mask=0,currentCount=null){
  // V11 empirical transition engine: all PA state changes are driven by the
  // chronologically validated 2021-2024 Retrosheet transition table with
  // shrinkage selected on 2024 and locked validation on 2025.
  if(!lineup.length){
    const fallback=[.70,.20,.07,.02,.006,.003,.001];
    return currentCount?applyHistoricalCountState(fallback,outs,mask,currentCount):fallback;
  }
  const memo=new Map();
  const cap=6;
  function rec(o,m,i,depth){
    if(o>=3||depth>=18) return [1,0,0,0,0,0,0];
    const key=`${o}|${m}|${i}|${depth}`;
    if(memo.has(key)) return memo.get(key);
    const probs=outcomeProb(lineup[i]?.id,pitcherId,null);
    const ni=(i+1)%lineup.length;
    const ans=[0,0,0,0,0,0,0];
    function add(weight,runs,next){
      for(let k=0;k<next.length;k++) ans[Math.min(cap,runs+k)]+=weight*next[k];
    }
    for(const [kind,pk] of [['out',probs.out],['bb',probs.bb],['single',probs.single],['double',probs.double],['triple',probs.triple],['hr',probs.hr]]){
      for(const t of empiricalPATransitions(kind,o,m)){
        const no=Math.min(3,o+Number(t.outs_added||0));
        const nm=no>=3?0:Number(t.post_mask||0);
        add(pk*Number(t.p||0),Number(t.runs||0),rec(no,nm,ni,depth+1));
      }
    }
    const total=ans.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)||1;
    for(let k=0;k<ans.length;k++) ans[k]/=total;
    memo.set(key,ans);
    return ans;
  }
  const raw=rec(outs,mask,startIdx,0);
  return currentCount?applyHistoricalCountState(raw,outs,mask,currentCount):raw;
}

function mixDistributions(a,b,weightA=.5){
  const w=clamp(Number(weightA)||0,0,1), n=Math.max(a?.length||0,b?.length||0,7), out=Array(n).fill(0);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++) out[i]=w*(a?.[i]||0)+(1-w)*(b?.[i]||0);
  const t=out.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)||1; return out.map(x=>x/t);
}
function convolveRunDistributions(a,b){
  const out=Array(7).fill(0);
  for(let i=0;i<(a?.length||0);i++) for(let j=0;j<(b?.length||0);j++) out[Math.min(6,i+j)]+=(a[i]||0)*(b[j]||0);
  const t=out.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)||1; return out.map(x=>x/t);
}
function projectedContinuationProbability(live,side,pid){
  if(!pid)return 0;
  const box=live?.boxscore||{}, ids=(box?.teams?.[side]?.pitchers||[]).map(String);
  const isStarter=ids[0]===String(pid);
  const stored=dynamicPitcherState.get(String(pid))||{};
  const pitches=num(pitcherPitches(box,pid,side));
  const profile=derivedProfiles[String(pid)]||deriveProfile(String(pid));
  const capacity=Math.max(20,stored.capacity||profile.expectedPitchCapacity||(isStarter?90:32));
  const workload=stored.workload!=null?stored.workload:pitches/capacity;
  const line=playerObj(box,side,pid)?.stats?.pitching||{};
  const bf=Math.max(1,num(line.battersFaced,1));
  const tto=stored.tto||Math.floor((bf-1)/9)+1;
  const deterioration=stored.deterioration||0;
  let p=isStarter?.97:.82;
  p-=Math.max(0,workload-.52)*(isStarter?.88:1.05);
  p-=Math.max(0,tto-2)*(isStarter?.09:.03);
  p-=deterioration*.50;
  if(!isStarter&&workload>.60)p-=.10;
  return clamp(p,.10,.98);
}
function projectedNextHalfDistribution(live,pitchingSide,battingLineup,startIdx,pregameSeed=null){
  const pid=currentPitcherId(live,pitchingSide);
  if(!pid){
    if(Array.isArray(pregameSeed)) return {dist:pregameSeed,pitcherId:null,continueProb:null,mode:'pregame baseline'};
    return {dist:runDistribution(battingLineup,startIdx,null,0,0,null),pitcherId:null,continueProb:0,mode:'bullpen baseline'};
  }
  const continueDist=runDistribution(battingLineup,startIdx,pid,0,0,null);
  const bullpenDist=runDistribution(battingLineup,startIdx,null,0,0,null);
  const continueProb=projectedContinuationProbability(live,pitchingSide,pid);
  return {dist:mixDistributions(continueDist,bullpenDist,continueProb),pitcherId:pid,continueProb,mode:'projected'};
}
function combinedInningHTML(currentAdditionalDist,runsScored,nextHalfDist,completedTopRuns=null){
  const currentFinal=finalRunDistribution(currentAdditionalDist,runsScored);
  // Top half: combine projected final top + projected bottom.
  // Bottom half: top-half runs are already known, so add that deterministic total
  // to the projected final bottom. Never cross into the next inning.
  const combined=completedTopRuns===null
    ?convolveRunDistributions(currentFinal,nextHalfDist)
    :shiftRunDistribution(currentFinal,completedTopRuns);
  const m=distributionMetrics(combined);
  const p0=combined[0]||0;
  const rows=[['0',p0],['1+',m.p1plus],['2+',m.p2plus],['3+',m.p3plus],['4+',m.p4plus]];
  const cell=([label,p])=>`<div class="combined-inning-cell"><span>${label}</span><b>${Math.round(p*100)}%</b><small>${p>=.999999?'—':oddsText(fairOdds(p))}</small></div>`;
  return `<div class="combined-inning">
    <div class="combined-inning-head"><span class="combined-inning-title">Inning Run Probability</span><span class="combined-inning-exp">Exp <b>${m.expected.toFixed(2)}</b> runs</span></div>
    <div class="combined-inning-grid">${rows.map(cell).join('')}</div>
  </div>`;
}

function distributionMetrics(dist){
  const p0=dist[0]||0;
  const p1plus=1-p0;
  const p2plus=dist.slice(2).reduce((a,b)=>a+(b||0),0);
  const p3plus=dist.slice(3).reduce((a,b)=>a+(b||0),0);
  const p4plus=dist.slice(4).reduce((a,b)=>a+(b||0),0);
  const expected=(dist[1]||0)+2*(dist[2]||0)+3*(dist[3]||0)+4*(dist[4]||0)+5*(dist[5]||0)+6.5*(dist[6]||0);
  return {p1plus,p2plus,p3plus,p4plus,expected};
}

function inningOrdinalLabel(n){
  const x=Math.max(1,Number(n)||1), mod100=x%100, mod10=x%10;

function immediateHalfRollover(g){
  const live=g?.liveData||{},ls=live.linescore||{},cp=live.plays?.currentPlay||{};
  if(groupState(gameState(g))!=='live')return {active:false};
  const inning=Math.max(1,num(ls.currentInning,1));
  const officialBattingSide=ls.isTopInning===false?'home':'away';

  // Do NOT wait for currentPlay.about.isComplete. MLB can leave that administrative
  // flag false for many seconds after the third out is already present in event/count data.
  // Use the earliest structured third-out signal available.
  const eventOuts=(cp.playEvents||[]).reduce((m,e)=>Math.max(m,num(e?.count?.outs,0)),0);
  const outs=Math.max(num(ls.outs,0),num(cp.count?.outs,0),eventOuts);
  if(outs<3)return {active:false};

  const awayRuns=num(ls.teams?.away?.runs??g?.teams?.away?.score,0);
  const homeRuns=num(ls.teams?.home?.runs??g?.teams?.home?.score,0);

  // Do not invent another half when the third out should end the game.
  const terminalAfterThirdOut=inning>=9 && (
    (officialBattingSide==='away' && homeRuns>awayRuns) ||
    (officialBattingSide==='home' && awayRuns!==homeRuns)
  );
  if(terminalAfterThirdOut)return {active:false,terminal:true};

  const battingSide=officialBattingSide==='away'?'home':'away';
  const fieldingSide=officialBattingSide;
  const nextInning=officialBattingSide==='home'?inning+1:inning;
  const half=battingSide==='away'?'TOP':'BOTTOM';
  return {
    active:true,
    officialBattingSide,
    battingSide,
    fieldingSide,
    inning:nextInning,
    half,
    ordinal:inningOrdinalLabel(nextInning),
    detectedAt:Date.now()
  };
}

async function getJSON(url,{timeoutMs=CONTEXT_TIMEOUT_MS,signal=null}={}){

async function loadTeamRosters(games, date, force=false){

async function loadSeasonStats(games, season, force=false){
  const requirements=new Map();
  const require=(id,group,field)=>{
    if(!id) return;
    const key=String(id);
    if(!requirements.has(key)) requirements.set(key,[]);
    requirements.get(key).push([group,field]);
  };
  games.forEach(g=>{
    const live=g.liveData||{}, box=live.boxscore||{};
    ['away','home'].forEach(side=>{
      const pid=currentPitcherId(live,side)||g.gameData?.probablePitchers?.[side]?.id||g.teams?.[side]?.probablePitcher?.id;
      require(pid,'pitching','era');
      activeLineup(box,side).forEach(p=>require(p.id,'hitting','ops'));
      rosterForGame(g,side).forEach(p=>{
        if(p.positionType==='Pitcher') require(p.id,'pitching','era');
        else if(p.positionType==='Two-Way Player'){require(p.id,'hitting','ops');require(p.id,'pitching','era')}
        else require(p.id,'hitting','ops');
      });
    });
    const cp=live.plays?.currentPlay||{};
    require(cp.matchup?.pitcher?.id,'pitching','era');
    require(cp.matchup?.batter?.id,'hitting','ops');
  });

  const now=Date.now();
  const fetchIds=[];
  for(const [id,needs] of requirements){
    const complete=needs.every(([group,field])=>hasStat(id,group,field));
    const meta=statFetchMeta[id]||{};
    if((force||!complete) && !statFetchPending.has(id) && now>=(meta.nextRetry||0)) fetchIds.push(id);
  }
  if(!fetchIds.length) return false;
  fetchIds.forEach(id=>statFetchPending.add(id));
  try{
    const incoming={};
    for(let i=0;i<fetchIds.length;i+=STAT_BATCH_SIZE){
      const batch=fetchIds.slice(i,i+STAT_BATCH_SIZE);
      const data=await getJSON(`${API}?type=peopleStats&ids=${encodeURIComponent(batch.join(','))}&season=${encodeURIComponent(season)}`);
      Object.assign(incoming,data.players||{});
    }
    seasonStats={...seasonStats,...incoming};
    rebuildDerivedProfiles(Object.keys(incoming));
    persistDailyCache();
    for(const id of fetchIds){
      const needs=requirements.get(id)||[];
      const complete=needs.every(([group,field])=>{
        const v=incoming?.[id]?.[group]?.[field] ?? seasonStats?.[id]?.[group]?.[field];
        return v===0 || v!==undefined && v!==null && v!=='';
      });
      if(complete) statFetchMeta[id]={attempts:0,nextRetry:0,lastSuccess:Date.now()};
      else{
        const attempts=(statFetchMeta[id]?.attempts||0)+1;
        statFetchMeta[id]={attempts,nextRetry:Date.now()+Math.min(60000,2000*(2**Math.min(attempts,5)))};
      }
    }
    lastStatsFetch=Date.now();
    return true;
  }catch(e){
    for(const id of fetchIds){
      const attempts=(statFetchMeta[id]?.attempts||0)+1;
      statFetchMeta[id]={attempts,nextRetry:Date.now()+Math.min(60000,2000*(2**Math.min(attempts,5)))};
    }
    console.warn('Season stats unavailable',e);
    return false;
  }finally{
    fetchIds.forEach(id=>statFetchPending.delete(id));
  }
}

function msToStart(g){return new Date(g?.gameDate||0).getTime()-Date.now()}

function pregamePhase(){

function scheduleCadence(){

  const starts=cache.map(g=>new Date(g.gameDate||0).getTime()-now).filter(x=>Number.isFinite(x)&&x>0);
  const next=starts.length?Math.min(...starts):Infinity;
  return next<=30*60*1000?60000:next<=3*60*60*1000?5*60*1000:15*60*1000;

function nextGamePollDelay(g){
  const state=gameState(g), cp=g.liveData?.plays?.currentPlay||{};
  if(['Final','Game Over','Completed Early'].includes(state))return null;
  if(/delay|postpon/i.test(state))return DELAY_POLL_MS;
  // Once the local third-out rollover is active, keep checking MLB frequently enough
  // to reconcile the official inning state without waiting on the normal break cadence.
  if(immediateHalfRollover(g).active)return TURNOVER_CONFIRM_POLL_MS;
  if(cp.about?.isComplete===false)return ACTIVE_POLL_MS;
  const abstract=g.gameData?.status?.abstractGameState||g.status?.abstractGameState;
  if(abstract==='Live')return BETWEEN_BATTERS_MS;
  return BREAK_POLL_MS;
}
function classifyEventChange(before,after){

  const bp=before?.liveData?.plays?.currentPlay||{}, ap=after?.liveData?.plays?.currentPlay||{};
  const structural=gameState(before)!==gameState(after)||bp.matchup?.pitcher?.id!==ap.matchup?.pitcher?.id||bp.matchup?.batter?.id!==ap.matchup?.batter?.id||bl.currentInning!==al.currentInning;
  const plate=structural||bl.outs!==al.outs||bl.teams?.away?.runs!==al.teams?.away?.runs||bl.teams?.home?.runs!==al.teams?.home?.runs||!!bl.offense?.first!==!!al.offense?.first||!!bl.offense?.second!==!!al.offense?.second||!!bl.offense?.third!==!!al.offense?.third;
  const micro=plate||bl.balls!==al.balls||bl.strikes!==al.strikes||bp.playEvents?.length!==ap.playEvents?.length;
  return structural?'structural':plate?'plate':micro?'micro':'none';
}

  try{
    const detail=await getJSON(`${API}?type=feed&gamePk=${encodeURIComponent(gamePk)}&_=${Date.now()}`,{timeoutMs:LIVE_TIMEOUT_MS,signal:ac.signal});
    if(seq!==c.sequence||gameControllers.get(key)!==c)return;
    const updated=mergeGame(base,detail), tier=classifyEventChange(base,updated);
    cache=cache.map(g=>String(g.gamePk)===key?updated:g);
    updateDynamicPitcherState(updated);
    refreshSavantGame(gamePk,false).then(changed=>{if(changed){updateDynamicPitcherState(updated);render(false,new Set([key]))}});
    const latencyMs=performance.now()-started;
    const previous=feedHealth.get(key)||{};
    const sourceDataAt=mlbStateTimestamp(detail)||Date.now();
    feedHealth.set(key,{...previous,lastSuccessAt:Date.now(),sourceDataAt,latencyMs,failures:0,tier,pollMs:c.currentInterval,timerDriftMs:drift,backgroundThrottled:drift>2500});
    c.failures=0;
    lastFeedReceivedAt=new Date();
    if(tier==='structural'){
      const season=String(new Date(dateInput.value+'T12:00:00').getFullYear());
      loadSeasonStats([updated],season,false).then(changed=>{if(changed)render(false,new Set([key]))});
    }
    if(tier!=='none'||Date.now()-(c.lastHealthRender||0)>2000){render(false,new Set([key]));c.lastHealthRender=Date.now()}else{updateMetrics();updateHealthDisplay(key)}
    const state=gameState(updated);
    if(groupState(state)!=='live'){
      if(groupState(state)==='final')queuePostgameCloseout(updated);
      stopGameController(key);scheduleScheduleRefresh(0);runOvernightScheduler(false);return
    }
    c.currentInterval=nextGamePollDelay(updated)||BREAK_POLL_MS;
  }catch(e){
    const stillCurrent=gameControllers.get(key)===c;
    if(!stillCurrent)return;
    if(e.name!=='AbortError')console.warn(`Game ${gamePk} live feed`,e);
    c.failures=(c.failures||0)+1;
    feedHealth.set(key,{...(feedHealth.get(key)||{}),failures:c.failures,lastErrorAt:Date.now()});
    c.currentInterval=Math.min(5000,ACTIVE_POLL_MS*Math.pow(1.7,Math.min(c.failures,4)));
  }finally{
    clearTimeout(timeout);
    const current=gameControllers.get(key);
    if(current===c){
      c.inFlight=false;
      c.abortController=null;
      scheduleGamePoll(key,c.currentInterval||ACTIVE_POLL_MS);
    }
    const now=new Date();document.getElementById('mRefresh').textContent=now.toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit'});
  }
}
function syncGameControllers(){
  const liveIds=new Set(cache.filter(g=>groupState(gameState(g))==='live').map(g=>String(g.gamePk)));
  [...gameControllers.keys()].forEach(id=>{if(!liveIds.has(id))stopGameController(id)});
  liveIds.forEach(id=>{if(!gameControllers.has(id))startGameController(id,0)});
}
function liveWatchdogTick(){
  if(!autoEl.checked||document.hidden)return;
  const now=Date.now();
  const liveGames=cache.filter(g=>groupState(gameState(g))==='live');
  for(const g of liveGames){
    const key=String(g.gamePk), c=gameControllers.get(key), h=feedHealth.get(key)||{};
    if(!c){
      startGameController(key,0);
      continue;
    }
    const reference=h.lastSuccessAt||c.createdAt||now;
    const transportAge=now-reference;
    const requestAge=c.inFlight?now-(c.lastPollStartedAt||now):0;
    const deadTimer=!c.inFlight&&!c.timer;
    const staleTransport=transportAge>LIVE_STALE_RESTART_MS && (!c.inFlight||requestAge>LIVE_TIMEOUT_MS+500);
    const cooldownElapsed=now-(h.lastWatchdogRestartAt||0)>LIVE_WATCHDOG_RESTART_COOLDOWN_MS;
    if((deadTimer||staleTransport)&&cooldownElapsed){
      feedHealth.set(key,{...h,lastWatchdogRestartAt:now});
      restartGameController(key,deadTimer?'watchdog-missing-timer':'watchdog-stale-feed');
    }
    updateHealthDisplay(key);
  }
}
function startLiveWatchdog(){
  clearInterval(liveWatchdogTimer);
  liveWatchdogTimer=setInterval(liveWatchdogTick,LIVE_WATCHDOG_TICK_MS);
  liveWatchdogTick();
}
function stopLiveWatchdog(){
  clearInterval(liveWatchdogTimer);
  liveWatchdogTimer=null;
}
async function prepareContext(force=false){
  const season=String(new Date(dateInput.value+'T12:00:00').getFullYear());
  const phase=pregamePhase();
  try{
    if(force||['roster','probables','lineup','lock','live-window'].includes(phase)){
      const rosterChanged=await loadTeamRosters(cache,dateInput.value,force);if(rosterChanged)markSource('rosters',true);
    }
    const savantDue=force||Date.now()-num(savantFetchMeta.leaderboards)>=SAVANT_PROFILE_TTL_MS;
    if(savantDue)loadSavantLeaderboards(season,force).then(changed=>{if(changed){markSource('savant',true);render(true)}}).catch(e=>markSource('savant',false,e));
    const statsDue=force||Date.now()-lastStatsFetch>contextCadence();
    if(statsDue)loadSeasonStats(cache,season,force).then(changed=>{if(changed){markSource('stats',true);render(true)}}).catch(e=>markSource('stats',false,e));
  }catch(e){console.warn('Context preparation',e)}
}
async function refreshSchedule(force=false){
  if(loading)return;loading=true;statusEl.textContent='Refreshing schedule/context…';
  try{
    const date=dateInput.value, nowMs=Date.now();
    const sched=await getJSON(`${API}?type=schedule&date=${encodeURIComponent(date)}`,{timeoutMs:CONTEXT_TIMEOUT_MS});
    const base=(sched.dates||[]).flatMap(d=>d.games||[]), priorMap=new Map(cache.map(g=>[String(g.gamePk),g]));
    cache=base.map(g=>mergeGame(g,priorMap.get(String(g.gamePk))));
    lastScheduleFetch=nowMs;lastPregameFetch=nowMs;cache.filter(isFinalState).forEach(queuePostgameCloseout);render(true);syncGameControllers();runOvernightScheduler(false);
    prepareContext(force);
    markSource('schedule',true);statusEl.textContent=`Connected · ${pregamePhase()} priority · ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}`;
  }catch(e){markSource('schedule',false,e);statusEl.textContent='Connection error';console.warn(e)}finally{loading=false;scheduleScheduleRefresh(sourceBackoff('schedule',scheduleCadence()))}
}
function scheduleScheduleRefresh(delay=scheduleCadence()){
  clearTimeout(scheduleTimer);if(autoEl.checked)scheduleTimer=setTimeout(()=>refreshSchedule(false),delay);
}
function startIndependentLanes(){
  clearTimeout(oddsTimer);clearTimeout(contextTimer);clearTimeout(pregameTimer);scheduleScheduleRefresh(scheduleCadence());
  const oddsLoop=async()=>{if(autoEl.checked){await refreshOdds(false);oddsTimer=setTimeout(oddsLoop,sourceBackoff('odds',oddsCadence()))}};
  const contextLoop=async()=>{if(autoEl.checked){await prepareContext(false);contextTimer=setTimeout(contextLoop,contextCadence())}};
  const pregameLoop=async()=>{if(autoEl.checked){await refreshPregameDetails(false);pregameTimer=setTimeout(pregameLoop,pregameDetailCadence())}};
  oddsLoop();contextLoop();pregameLoop();startOvernightLane();syncGameControllers();startLiveWatchdog();
}
function stopIndependentLanes(){
  clearTimeout(scheduleTimer);clearTimeout(oddsTimer);clearTimeout(contextTimer);clearTimeout(pregameTimer);stopLiveWatchdog();stopOvernightLane();[...gameControllers.keys()].forEach(stopGameController);
}
function setTimer(){if(autoEl.checked)startIndependentLanes();else stopIndependentLanes()}
function load(){return refreshSchedule(true)}
document.getElementById('refresh').addEventListener('click',()=>{refreshSchedule(true);refreshOdds(true)});
dateInput.addEventListener('change',()=>{stopIndependentLanes();cache=[];seasonStats={};derivedProfiles={};statcastProfiles={};statcastGames={};statcastLiveAdjustments.clear();savantFetchMeta={leaderboards:0,games:{},lastError:null};dynamicPitcherState.clear();statFetchMeta={};statFetchPending=new Set();rosterCache={};rosterFetchPending=new Set();restoreDailyCache();refreshSchedule(true).then(setTimer)});
filter.addEventListener('change',()=>render(true));
sortSelect.addEventListener('change',()=>render(true));
autoEl.addEventListener('change',setTimer);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{
  if(document.hidden){statusEl.textContent='Background tab · iPhone may throttle updates';return}
  statusEl.textContent='Foreground · resynchronizing';
  // Recreate every live controller. Merely clearing its timer leaves the controller
  // in the map and syncGameControllers() would otherwise assume it was still running.
  restartAllLiveGameControllers('foreground-resync');
  startLiveWatchdog();
  refreshSchedule(false);
  refreshOdds(true);
  cache.filter(g=>groupState(gameState(g))==='live').forEach(g=>refreshSavantGame(g.gamePk,true));
});
restoreOvernightState();restoreDailyCache();refreshSchedule(true).then(setTimer);
</script>
